observed.scope: The first actual Linux mismatch proves tie sensitivity within the score tolerance. It does not establish every case/order/aggregate difference or the precise compiler/FMA cause.

unchanged: Production score functions and exact floating equality/stable tie rules
Root supervision, family roles, quality gates and pendingFit policy

alternatives.name: Separate pinned platform goldens plus invariant audit
alternatives.fit: Strong platform-specific reproducibility; less portable and more baseline maintenance.
alternatives.method: Retain Mac report unchanged; capture complete Linux report under exact Go/GOARCH/GOAMD64/source/data pins, review it separately, then add a versioned platform-specific expectation. Each report still passes independent score-order/tie/mapping/visit/aggregate checks.
advantages: All fields can remain exact within one pinned platform recipe
Platform differences remain explicit historical evidence
costs: No legitimate Linux golden yet: first actual full report must be captured and reviewed
Go/GOAMD64/compiler upgrades can require new expectations; risk of blindly updating to failing output
Architecture-specific report pairs do not prove architecture-independent ranks
alternatives.condition: Never overwrite Mac or silently bless Linux outcomes. A raw golden refresh alone is insufficient.

alternatives.name: One Mac numerical reference plus strict actual-report invariants and robust pair order
alternatives.fit: Most direct correction of the wrong architecture-exactness requirement while retaining strong checks and production behavior.
alternatives.method: Preserve every raw Linux/Mac score and exact within-report consequence. Compare all raw scores to Mac under the existing tolerance. Validate actual structure/arithmetic independently. Cross-platform rank constraints apply exactly to robust separated pairs; overlapping score intervals are explicitly architecture-sensitive, with all differing ties/orders/visits/aggregates recorded.
advantages: Does not redefine production ties or round scores
No widening of existing epsilon or discarded diagnostics
Works with future platform/compiler variance while detecting changed far-apart ranks and forged consequences
costs: Cross-platform exact ranking equivalence is no longer claimed for near pairs
Needs a dedicated independent bookkeeping validator and meaningful tamper controls
Full actual report preservation is required, not just the first mismatch log
alternatives.condition: Do not erase TiedPairs/orders/visits/aggregate fields before comparison or use a blanket ignore. Freeze this corrected test contract and retain failed runs.

recommended_contract.score_check: For each active score i, ε_i=1e-12*max(1,abs(Mac_i)); require finite raw actual and abs(actual_i-Mac_i)<=ε_i. All inactive scores/order slots must be zero. Compare before any temporary normalization.
recommended_contract.robust_pair_check: For every active pair i,j with Mac_i-Mac_j > ε_i+ε_j, actual ordering must keep i ahead of j. The opposite case is symmetric. Overlap means cross-platform numeric order may be sensitive; it is not a new tolerance tie for production.
within_actual_checks: Exact data pin/schema/state/33parents/96selected/219cases/876ranks/counts and fixed lexicographic primary/permutation schedule
Case n2/3, exact parent IDs/labels/styles/mapping/fallback/kind; every active candidate exactly once, no omitted U reinsertion or new supervision

For each raw actual score pair, descending score order; equal actual scores use smaller display index first. TiedPairs equals exact actual score== on active pairs; unused pairs stay false. Use elementary independent comparisons, not Baselines/rank helper calls.
SelectedOrder[j]=DisplayToSelected[DisplayOrder[j]]; FirstPositiveVisit computed from immutable selected known labels after mapping

Recompute all Primary/Permuted integer totals from every case: case count, n visits without order, first-positive visits, top1/top3 and fallbacks. Recompute reduction=(unord-visits)/unord from those integers and require exact within-report value.

Existing per-score Mac bound validates ranking numerical values without recomputing the score functions. For an added independent fixed/lexical arithmetic checker, derive token integer counts from pinned public text; do not call Features/model or silently change the numerical recipe.
recommended_contract.cross_platform_bookkeeping: If within-actual checks and raw-score/robust-pair checks pass, retain differences as architecture-sensitive evidence. An aggregate difference is permitted only if exactly derived from recorded actual case changes, not ignored. The first log alone cannot establish that.
recommended_contract.artifact_requirement: Persist the complete raw actual Report from the existing audit call before test comparison:219cases/876rankings, source/data/runtime/GOAMD64 pins, bounded report output. Upload the safe report and difference summary even when the test fails. No additional audit/Reader/Baselines replay is necessary just to capture it.
meaningful_controls: Forged TiedPairs inconsistent with raw equal/unequal scores is rejected
Far-separated rank inversion, unstable exact tie, duplicate order or wrong mapped index is rejected
Near-pair valid stable raw ordering can differ from Mac while all actual consequences are correctly recorded
Incorrect first visit, aggregate integer total or reduction is rejected
Score outside unchanged epsilon, metadata drift, missing/extra case or unused slot contamination is rejected

not_recommended: Changing baseline mathematical formula or production tie comparator to force this golden
Quantizing scores/forcing Mac ties under a near-equality comparator
Ignoring every tie/order/aggregate difference or accepting a new golden without actual invariant review
Treating simulated candidate checks as real validation-cost/model-quality improvement
relation: Reviewer wrote the original bias-preparation helper and has prior source/Root scalar context, so nonblind. This is assessment of Root test contract and observed platform evidence; not independent reexecution/certification of own baseline code.
limit: FMA remains an implementation hypothesis, not independently confirmed actual Linux cause. No protected or historical raw validation inputs read.
